bio.text: Julie Gonzales, a Democrat, has represented District 34 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2019.
According to Ballotpedia, she ran for the U.S. Senate in Colorado and lost in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary, and she is not running for re-election to the state Senate in 2026.
Gonzales graduated from Yale University in 2005, moved to Denver, worked as a community organizer, and co-founded the Colorado Latino Forum in 2009.
